children: rose 1.82% premarket after Northland Capital initiated coverage at Outperform with a $99 price target, implying more than 100% upside from the prior close. It adds to an analyst base already skewed bullish, with 14 buy ratings and three holds before today.
The call follows JPMorgan's move on September 14, which raised IREN two notches from Underweight to Overweight with a $65 target, citing its Nvidia

cloud partnership and neocloud pricing power. IREN retired lower-margin Bitcoin mining hardware to redirect power toward AI compute, taking a large non-cash impairment in its fiscal 2026 results while lifting its contracted annual recurring revenue target to $4 billion for 2026.

title: IREN Shares Rise as Northland Targets $99
